messages:
anya: dropping a short UX check on the compact SLO editor: added a small 'Notify multiplier' control and an inline 'Who we will notify' preview. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ABCD/compact-slo
cam: nice and compact. one ask: make suppressed channels visible in the preview but clearly muted. users kept asking why a channel didn't ring.
rob: copy nit: label it 'Notify multiplier (SLO)' so PMs don't have to guess. tooltip can expand with examples: '1x = default; 2x = twice as aggressive'.
mika: accessibility: slider must support arrow key steps of 0.1, page up/down 0.5, and announce changes via aria-live. avoid verbose lists; summarize counts like 'PagerDuty (2), Email (1)'.
sam: visual: use a subtle muted badge 'suppressed' with 60% opacity for quiet-window channels. make them focusable so keyboard users can open quiet-window settings from the preview.
aria-bot: a11y check: slider role="slider", aria-valuemin="0.1", aria-valuemax="5", aria-valuenow updates. preview summary should be aria-live="polite" and no more than two short phrases to avoid screenreader flooding.
anya: performance: throttle preview updates to 140ms while dragging and show a tiny shimmer if computation takes >180ms. keeps the drag smooth.
cam: color/contrast: orange used for escalation needs to pass AA at small sizes; either darken the orange or add bold labels.
rob: UX question: when multiplier is >3x, show microcopy 'Preview approximate under high load' so expectations are set.
mika: tooltip on suppressed should appear on focus as well as hover; tooltips must use role="tooltip" and be referenced by aria-describedby.
anya: i'll update the frames with: label tweak, tooltip copy, keyboard increments, aria attributes, muted badge behavior, throttled preview, and the high-multiplier microcopy. will post updated link later today. :rocket:
